verdict.rationale: Jira advertises 3000+ Marketplace integrations and rich REST APIs (jira-docs-6, jira-docs-10, jira-comm-14) which could support bi-directional sync with code repo issue trackers like GitHub/GitLab, but no direct evidence of a native, purpose-built bi-directional sync feature for external repo trackers is provided—only generic integration/API claims and third-party marketplace reliance.
